summary: The ink opening's eye is redrawn after three reference engravings (an anatomical plate, Fornasetti's eye, a vintage cross-hatched eye): a pen vocabulary any subject can use (hairline to swell, tapers, black by crossing, stipple, dropped lines), the socket as rings round the eye under a held light, the white's shade fixed to the face, and every part redrawn (brow, lashes, lids, iris, caruncle, veins, the star's needles).
decisions: A line's width is its tone: a continuous hairline in the light, swelling in the shade; flicks only at the faintest
Black is crossed, not flooded: one family never merges into solid black, a second family crossing it makes the dark
The socket is one family of rings between the lids' fold and the orbit's rim, relaxing the corners with distance; it frays out inside the loader's frame
The socket's light is a height field lit from the upper left, its shade held to a mid tone, with designed darks under the brow, by the nose, at the outer corner and in the tear trough
The shade on the white belongs to the face: lines fixed to the face cross the globe's arcs and stay put as the gaze turns; the white is cut at the plica so the caruncle stays in front
The pen's method lives in the repo as ideas/studio-dawn/ink-strokes.md (the local stroke skill is not in git)
